ONE PIECE CARD GAME Official Card Q&A
Updated: September 1, 2025
©Eiichiro Oda/Shueisha, Toei Animation

OP05-119 Monkey.D.Luffy
Q1. If I activate this Character's [On Play] effect while ST10-001 is on my field,
do I take an extra turn after the current End Phase?
A1. Yes. According to Rule 7-1-4-1, the extra turn begins immediately after the
current turn ends, provided you returned 10 DON!! cards to your DON!! deck.

Q2
Can I choose 1-2 cards when resolving an effect updated on 2025-09-01?
A2
Only when the card text explicitly permits choosing up to that many targets.

Page 1 of 2

OP01-029 Radical Beam!!
Q3: Can I activate this Counter Event during the Counter Step if my opponent attacked P-001
while EB01-001 and PRB01-001 are in play?
A3: Yes. Refer to 10-1-1 and 9-9-9-9 for timing details during battle.

General Rules Q&A
Q4. How many times can [Blocker] be activated during a single battle?
A4. Only once per battle (see Rules 7-1-4 and 7-1-5).
A Character with [Blocker] must be rested to redirect the attack.
